name: Recall
notes: Recall (the Brain) and plugin knowledge tabs; top-level features only

features.feature: Recall is in the activity bar only while a plugin adds a Knowledge tab, and shows only those tabs; without one `#brain` (and the old `#brain/sources`, `#brain/people`) opens Calls; with one, an address of a tab Echo no longer has opens the plugin's first tab

Settings → Intake → Use Intake turns reading the threads' mail and channels on or off; its card shows when they were last read, Sync now and Keep it current; below it the search card (how much Claude asked it, what it holds) and the optional re-ranker's embedding server, model and key
Settings → Intake → Who may speak: which senders' mail and channel posts are read is decided per client (Trust, Ignore, Read anyway, Keep out, Forget), whether Intake is on or off

Claude sessions get Echo's search as a read-only MCP server scoped to their AI profile: search_sources, list_sources, read_source, read_link and list_scopes only; who people are and how things relate are left to the Knowledge plugin
Plugins add tabs to Recall (its only content) and rows to Settings → Intake (e.g. Obsidian vaults)

Recall search finds the query's words (English, Ukrainian and Russian stopwords skipped, names and threads linked in the minutes' Who and Thread lines not indexed) and, when an embedding server answers, orders those hits by meaning without adding others

Recall search (`echoctl brain search`, MCP search_sources) narrows by source kind (call, mail, channel, document), section kind (summary, decisions, action items, open questions, other minutes, transcript, chat, mail, channel, document, card), days (since / until; without them a date said in the query, in English, Ukrainian or Russian, such as "12 November" or "last week") and who said it, before the hits are cut; unknown kinds and malformed days are refused

Recall's index is working memory: transcripts and chats leave it after 45 days, minutes, mail and channel facts after 90, and a closed thread's sections when it closes; every call keeps a card (title, day, threads, people, the summary's first line) and a closed thread's document a card (title, path, headings); a search reaching past that says "older than the index keeps"; the call folders, files and Intake's facts are never touched, and a thread opened again gets its sections back

Intake keeps the facts read from mail and channel posts as one file per source, apart from the index; a source read again is merged into its file (nothing older dropped); dated backups (7 days) before a sync changes them; moved there once from the old index; a fact file goes only when its source leaves its thread (never on a short thread list or a mass removal), and an ignored sender's sections only on the user's Ignore or Keep out

After an update Echo removes the index's old snapshots and the page reader's page images (`recall/snapshots/`, `recall/assets/`) once; Intake's facts, the dictionary, the senders and the sources' state stay
